android.desc:
Access the world's knowledge offline with Kiwix! Download free educational content once and browse it anytime, anywhere - no internet connection needed.
Kiwix uses advanced compression technology to store vast amounts of content whilst taking minimal space on your device. Whether you're travelling, have limited internet access, or simply want to save on data costs, Kiwix puts reliable information at your fingertips.

Need help? Our team is available at info@kiwix.org should you need any clarifications or support.

Support us! Kiwix is a non-profit and displays no ads nor collects any data. Feel free to donate here: https://kiwix.org/en/get-involved/#donate
